summary.materialDecision: Retain supplied opaque three-stop painted palette, low-opacity corner motif, sage edge and lower lip. Three-choice layout adapts to actual panel width (three at390portrait/desktop, two-plus-one at844/780/360).

limitations: 780x320 Harbor future copy and projected load require normal vertical body scrolling;360x740 projected Harbor load also requires it. Scrolled images intentionally crop upper choices vertically while fixedClose/Confirm stay available.
780x320 Settings keeps secondary Fullscreen in internal scrolling.
Known selected-card/dock overlap and desktop Wholecove/secondary-hint overlap are not declared resolved.
Native-font, physicalAndroid, other-engine/nativeGPU, acoustic and fullaccessibility certification not claimed.

Additional320x740 actual-game views keep full names/costs visible; longer title/requirement/copy wrap and the final Harbor consequence requires normal vertical body scrolling. No extra typography reduction or horizontal clipping was observed.
